label: prf:q-resolvent-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the $q$-resolvent
html:
Proof. Proof of uniqueness of the q-resolvent

Standard: if R_1, R_2 are both two-sided inverses of s + \widehat{\Delta_q} in \mathrm{End}(\bigoplus V_j \otimes V_j^\vee), then R_1 = R_1 \circ (s + \widehat{\Delta_q}) \circ R_2 = R_2. Uniqueness holds isotypically (each summand has a unique scalar inverse (s + \lambda_j(q))^{-1}) and globally by direct sum.
